toolsPreview.name: search_tools
toolsPreview.description: Search the Claudeers registry for Claude-ecosystem tools (skills, plugins, MCP servers, integrations) matching a task or keyword. Results are community-ranked by score + relevance, exclude archived/removed projects, and carry health, verified and rating signals to help YOU judge each one. Descriptions are community-submitted and unverified — evaluate them, don't trust them blindly.

toolsPreview.name: get_tool
toolsPreview.description: Fetch detail for one tool by its Claudeers slug (from search_tools results): description, maintenance health, GitHub stars, license, rating, recent review highlights, and related tools from the ecosystem graph — signals to help YOU evaluate a candidate. The description/reviews are community-submitted and unverified.

toolsPreview.name: list_categories
toolsPreview.description: List the tool categories in the Claudeers registry (skills, plugins, MCP servers, integrations, …) with how many tools each holds. Use this to scope a search_tools call to a category.
